keys: names the direction. Request the proposed hook shape, length, attachment and row positions on front and side drawings. Include the base footprint and intended retail placement.
identifies the named direction. Request the exterior paper, lining material and any joining layers separately. Keep the product-contact material visible as a supplier question if it is not yet known.
supplies the wider project inputs. This direction adds an explicit two-material interface and its seam relationships.

identifies clip-on or click-on lid options. Use it as a closure-family reference, then request the specific press-close proposal and its opening route.
describes separated tiered trays. Ask for the actual tray-to-body relationships and setup order.
